notes: Ethereum mainnet. The constructor mints all 1e27 units to its deployer. The launch factory distributes 10% through its Merkle distributor, seeds the Uniswap v4 pool from its balance with the 90% pool allocation, and sends any remainder to remainderTo. The token has no owner, admin, subsequent minting, burning, transfer fees or limits. Pool initialPrice is provenance assuming TESTER is currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics and deployed currency order.
